en: A canopy bed. Pink. Very, very pink.
Well. Someone never left the dressing room.

If you're reading this, the Count mixed up the windows again. I'm only 97 and still quite lovely, but my prince never came. Don't eat his pies. And don't touch the wardrobe.

— Your predecessor, Princess R.
A canary. It watches me like it knows something I don't.
A hairpin. Bent just right for... something.
Powder, perfume and a very old hairbrush.
